# Digital Technology Partner

> Digital Technology Partner (DTP) says it helps leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into governed systems intended to create measurable operational value.

Source: https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/

## Programmes

- [AI programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/): DTP publicly offers an AI Adoption Readiness Sprint, AI Foundry and private senior-leadership AI coaching.
- [AI Adoption Readiness Sprint](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/): described by DTP as a one-week assessment of current AI use, risk, noise and opportunity.
- [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/): described by DTP as a twelve-week working group that turns experiments into evidence and leadership decisions, rather than a conventional course.
- [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/): described by DTP as confidential, private and one-to-one.

## Solutions and delivery

- [Solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/): DTP says it designs and builds dashboards, workflow automation, AI agents and bespoke business systems around workflow, data, people and governance.
- [Process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/): DTP describes five evidence gates, Discover, Prove, Build, Pilot and Launch, with a right to stop at each gate.
- [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/): DTP's public delivery principles, governance approach and buyer questions.

## Publishing and products

- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/): DTP's public writing on AI adoption, governance, delivery and automation.
- [Newsroom archive](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/archive/): the public archive of approved newsroom articles.
- [WhichLogin](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/apps/whichlogin/): a local-only macOS menu-bar app from DTP that records sign-in routes on the user's Mac.
- [10 Touches privacy](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/10-touches/privacy/): describes 10 Touches as a personal CRM whose production data stays locally on the device.

## Contact

- [Contact DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/contact/): public email and WhatsApp contact routes. DTP says it operates from Aberdeen and remotely.

- [Full machine-readable reference](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/llms-full.txt): expanded, source-linked descriptions of DTP's public pages.
